<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="fr">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Accueil — Maintex GMAO</title>
<style>
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Outfit:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800;900&family=DM+Sans:opsz,wght@9..40,300;9..40,400;9..40,500&display=swap');
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
:root{
  --navy:#0D1160;--indigo:#1A1DB5;--royal:#2B30D4;--blue:#3B82F6;--sky:#60A5FA;
  --ice:#EEF1FF;--ice2:#F4F6FD;--ink:#08091A;--ink2:#1C2040;--steel:#3B4470;
  --silver:#7A85A8;--mist:#F4F6FD;--white:#FFFFFF;--gold:#D97706;--green:#16A34A;
  --border:rgba(26,29,181,0.10);
}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;background:var(--white);color:var(--ink);overflow-x:hidden;line-height:1.6}
.nav{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:1000;background:rgba(8,9,26,0.97);backdrop-filter:blur(20px);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);transition:box-shadow .3s}
.nav-inner{max-width:1240px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 40px;height:70px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:24px}
.nav-logo img{height:30px;display:block;filter:brightness(0) invert(1)}
.nav-menu{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:2px;list-style:none}
.nav-menu>li{position:relative}
.nav-menu>li>a{padding:8px 13px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.6);text-decoration:none;font-size:14px;border-radius:6px;transition:all .2s;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;white-space:nowrap}
.nav-menu>li>a:hover,.nav-menu>li>a.active{color:var(--white);background:rgba(255,255,255,.06)}
.nav-menu>li>a .arr{font-size:10px;opacity:.5;transition:transform .2s}
.nav-menu>li:hover>a .arr{transform:rotate(180deg)}
.dropdown{display:none;position:absolute;top:calc(100% + 8px);left:0;background:rgba(10,12,30,0.98);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);border-radius:12px;padding:8px;min-width:230px;backdrop-filter:blur(20px);box-shadow:0 24px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}
.nav-menu>li:hover .dropdown{display:block}
.dropdown a{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:9px 12px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.6);text-decoration:none;font-size:13px;border-radius:8px;transition:all .2s}
.dropdown a:hover{color:var(--white);background:rgba(255,255,255,.06)}
.dropdown a .di{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:6px;background:rgba(59,130,246,.15);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:14px;flex-shrink:0}
.nav-cta{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center}
.btn-ghost-nav{padding:8px 16px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);color:rgba(255,255,255,.75);background:transparent;border-radius:6px;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;transition:all .2s;text-decoration:none}
.btn-ghost-nav:hover{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.4);color:var(--white)}
.btn-cta-nav{padding:9px 20px;background:var(--royal);color:var(--white);border:none;border-radius:6px;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;transition:all .2s;text-decoration:none}
.btn-cta-nav:hover{background:var(--indigo);transform:translateY(-1px)}
.eyebrow{font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--royal);font-weight:600;margin-bottom:14px}
.eyebrow.light{color:rgba(107,143,255,.85)}
h1,h2,h3{font-family:'Outfit',sans-serif;line-height:1.06}
h1{font-size:clamp(40px,5vw,66px);font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-3px}
h2{font-size:clamp(28px,3.5vw,48px);font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-2px}
h3{font-size:clamp(18px,2vw,22px);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-0.5px}
.gradient-text{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#6B8FFF 0%,#A5B4FF 60%,#C7D2FE 100%);-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;background-clip:text}
.text-dim{color:rgba(255,255,255,.35)}
.section-sub{font-size:16px;color:var(--silver);line-height:1.7;font-weight:300;max-width:560px}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:13px 26px;border-radius:8px;font-size:15px;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;transition:all .25s;text-decoration:none;border:none;line-height:1}
.btn-primary{background:var(--royal);color:var(--white)}
.btn-primary:hover{background:var(--indigo);transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 14px 36px rgba(27,29,181,.4)}
.btn-secondary{background:transparent;color:rgba(255,255,255,.75);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15)}
.btn-secondary:hover{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.4);color:var(--white)}
.btn-outline-dark{background:transparent;color:var(--navy);border:1.5px solid rgba(13,17,96,.2)}
.btn-outline-dark:hover{background:var(--ice);border-color:var(--royal);color:var(--royal)}
.btn-lg{padding:15px 34px;font-size:16px}
.btn-sm{padding:8px 16px;font-size:13px}
.container{max-width:1240px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 40px}
.section{padding:96px 0}
.section-sm{padding:64px 0}
.section-dark{background:var(--ink)}
.section-mist{background:var(--mist)}
.card{background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:16px;padding:32px;transition:all .3s}
.card:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(26,29,181,.1)}
.card-dark{background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);border-radius:16px;padding:32px;transition:all .3s}
.card-dark:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);border-color:rgba(59,130,246,.25)}
.hero-bg{background:var(--ink);position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.hero-bg::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background-image:linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.025) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.025) 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:72px 72px;pointer-events:none}
.glow-blue{position:absolute;width:900px;height:900px;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(27,29,181,.14) 0%,transparent 65%);pointer-events:none}
.glow-navy{position:absolute;width:600px;height:600px;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(13,17,96,.3) 0%,transparent 70%);pointer-events:none}
.badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;padding:6px 14px;border-radius:20px;font-size:12px;font-weight:500}
.badge-blue{background:rgba(59,130,246,.1);border:1px solid rgba(59,130,246,.25);color:rgba(96,165,250,.9)}
.badge-dot{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:currentColor;animation:blink 2s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes blink{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:.4}}
.stat-strip{display:flex;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;width:fit-content}
.stat-item{padding:14px 24px;text-align:center;border-right:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07)}
.stat-item:last-child{border-right:none}
.stat-val{font-family:'Outfit',sans-serif;font-size:26px;font-weight:800;color:var(--white);letter-spacing:-1px}
.stat-lbl{font-size:10px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.3);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.07em;margin-top:2px}
.tag{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;padding:4px 10px;background:var(--ice);border-radius:5px;font-size:11px;color:var(--steel);font-weight:500}
.form-group{margin-bottom:20px}
.form-label{display:block;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;color:var(--steel);margin-bottom:7px}
.form-input,.form-select{width:100%;padding:12px 16px;border:1.5px solid rgba(26,29,181,.15);border-radius:8px;font-size:14px;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;color:var(--ink);background:var(--white);transition:all .2s;outline:none}
.form-input:focus,.form-select:focus{border-color:var(--royal);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(27,29,181,.1)}
textarea.form-input{resize:vertical;min-height:120px}
footer{background:var(--ink);padding:72px 0 32px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.04)}
.footer-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:2.2fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:48px;margin-bottom:56px}
.footer-brand-desc{font-size:13px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.3);line-height:1.75;font-weight:300;margin-bottom:20px}
.footer-bbc-badge{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:12px 14px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06);border-radius:10px;margin-top:18px}
.footer-bbc-badge img{height:24px;filter:brightness(0) invert(1);opacity:.5}
.footer-bbc-badge span{font-size:11px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.25);line-height:1.4}
.footer-col h4{font-family:'Outfit',sans-serif;font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em;color:rgba(255,255,255,.3);margin-bottom:20px}
.footer-col a{display:block;font-size:13px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.38);text-decoration:none;margin-bottom:9px;transition:color .2s}
.footer-col a:hover{color:rgba(255,255,255,.8)}
.footer-bottom{border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.05);padding-top:22px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px}
.footer-legal{font-size:12px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.2)}
.footer-rgpd{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:11px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.22)}
.footer-rgpd-dot{width:6px;height:6px;background:#22c55e;border-radius:50%}
.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(24px);transition:opacity .65s ease,transform .65s ease}
.reveal.visible{opacity:1;transform:none}
.reveal-d1{transition-delay:.1s}.reveal-d2{transition-delay:.2s}.reveal-d3{transition-delay:.3s}.reveal-d4{transition-delay:.4s}
.back-top{position:fixed;bottom:28px;right:28px;background:var(--royal);color:var(--white);border:none;width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;cursor:pointer;font-size:18px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;box-shadow:0 4px 20px rgba(27,29,181,.4);transition:all .25s;z-index:999;opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
.back-top.show{opacity:1;pointer-events:all}
.back-top:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);background:var(--indigo)}
.cta-band{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--navy) 0%,var(--royal) 100%);padding:80px 0;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.cta-band::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:repeating-linear-gradient(45deg,transparent,transparent 60px,rgba(255,255,255,.022) 60px,rgba(255,255,255,.022) 120px)}
.page-hero{min-height:52vh;display:flex;align-items:center;padding-top:70px}
</style>
</head>
